archive.title: Huntington Avenue Grounds
archive.caption: Huntington Avenue Grounds was a baseball stadium in Boston, Massachusetts, and the first home field for the Boston Red Sox, known as the "Boston Americans" before 1908, from 1901 to 1911.

archive.title: Royal Rooters
archive.caption: The Royal Rooters were a fan club for Boston's professional baseball team in the American League in the early 20th century.

archive.title: Fenway Park
archive.caption: Fenway Park is a ballpark in Boston, Massachusetts, United States, close to Kenmore Square. Since 1912, it has been the home field of Major League Baseball's (MLB) Boston Red Sox.

archive.title: 1912 World Series
archive.caption: The 1912 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball for the 1912 season.

archive.title: 1916 World Series
archive.caption: The 1916 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball for the 1916 season.

archive.title: 1918 World Series
archive.caption: The 1918 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball for the 1918 season.

archive.title: 1946 World Series
archive.caption: The 1946 World Series was played in October 1946 between the St. Louis Cardinals and the Boston Red Sox. This was the Red Sox' first appearance in a World Series since their championship of 1918.
